page.layout: One page of text, centred dedication lines in large display type; no margins with text; faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.

main_text.head: VIRIS MAGNIFICIS, NOBILISSIMIS, AMPLISSIMIS, PRUDENTISSIMIS D. JO. RODOLPHO BURCARDO D. JO. LUDOVICO CRUCIO INCLYTAE REIPUBL. BASILEENSIS CONSULIBUS PATRIAE PATRIBUS MERITISS. ILLI E S. FONTE SUSCEPTORI HUIC PARENTI FILIALI OBSEQUIO DEVENERANDIS.
main_text.p: HOCCE STUDII SACRI SPECIMEN HUMILLIME INSCRIBIT:

page.notes: Display type in the original is rendered as printed: VIRIS in spaced capitals, MAGNIFICIS and NOBILISSIMIS in italic, the remaining names in roman capitals. The printer's "HOCCE" and "AVTHOR" are kept as printed. The dedication is set in a single block and its line breaks are not reproduced.
